trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts that performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. The claim to verify is: 'Kamal Haasan starred in a film directed by the director of Sundara Swapnagalu.'
trace_summary.final_output_summary: 24 documents returned across three hops. Hop 1 retrieved 7 documents establishing K. Balachander as director of Sundara Swapnagalu and showing Kamal Haasan starred in multiple K. Balachander films. Hop 2 retrieved 7 documents (duplicates of hop 1). Hop 3 retrieved 10 documents listing K. Balachander-Kamal Haasan collaborations.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed all seven specified steps successfully. Hop 1 retrieved comprehensive evidence that K. Balachander directed Sundara Swapnagalu and that Kamal Haasan starred in multiple K. Balachander films (Sollathaan Ninaikkiren, Aakali Rajyam, Punnagai Mannan). The summarizer correctly identified the claim as verified after hop 1. Query generator steps produced queries that, while redundant given the claim was already verified, were structurally valid and retrieved relevant documents. All three hops completed as specified, returning 24 total documents. The pipeline has no verification stage or early-exit condition by design, so completing all three hops with redundant evidence is correct behavior, not a failure.
